mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE (BINDING_REVISION, SOURCE_ACTION, INTENT_KEY, INTENT_FINGERPRINT, ID, SOURCE_COORD_ID, SOURCE_GENERATION, RESOURCE_COORD_ID, RESOURCE_GENERATION, SOURCE_ROW_ID, SOURCE_FINGERPRINT, WINDOWS, ACTION, STATE, REQUEST_ID, TARGET_ID, ATTEMPT_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (#{bindingRevision,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sourceAction,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{intentKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{intentFingerprint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceCoordId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceGeneration,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{resourceCoordId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resourceGeneration,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sourceRowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceFingerprint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{windows,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{action,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{state,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{targetId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{attemptId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE SET RESOURCE_GENERATION=#{resourceGeneration,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, STATE=#{state,jdbcType=VARCHAR},TARGET_ID=#{targetId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATE_TIME=#{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE ID=#{id} AND BINDING_REVISION=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT /*+ INDEX(C IX_ASR_RESOURCE) */ ,DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(C.WINDOWS) WINDOW_LENGTH, CASE WHEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(C.WINDOWS,1,1)='#' THEN 0 ELSE REGEXP_COUNT(C.WINDOWS,';')+1 END WINDOW_COUNT FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C JOIN SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD S ON S.ID=C.SOURCE_COORD_ID AND S.GENERATION=C.SOURCE_GENERATION WHERE C.RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resourceId} AND C.BINDING_REVISION=0 AND C.ACTION='ADD' AND S.ACTION='ADD' AND S.STATE IN ('ACTIVE','EXPANDING') ORDER BY C.SOURCE_COORD_ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1001

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,SOURCE_COORD_ID,SOURCE_GENERATION,RESOURCE_COORD_ID,RESOURCE_GENERATION,SOURCE_ROW_ID,SOURCE_FINGERPRINT,ACTION,STATE,REQUEST_ID,TARGET_ID,ATTEMPT_ID,BINDING_REVISION,SOURCE_ACTION,INTENT_KEY,INTENT_FINGERPRINT FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE WHERE SOURCE_COORD_ID = #{sourceId} AND SOURCE_GENERATION = #{generation} AND BINDING_REVISION=0 ORDER BY RESOURCE_COORD_ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT H.RESOURCE_COORD_ID) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE H WHERE H.SOURCE_COORD_ID = #{sourceId} AND H.BINDING_REVISION=0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C WHERE C.SOURCE_COORD_ID = H.SOURCE_COORD_ID AND C.RESOURCE_COORD_ID = H.RESOURCE_COORD_ID AND C.SOURCE_GENERATION = #{generation} AND C.BINDING_REVISION=0)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,SOURCE_COORD_ID,SOURCE_GENERATION,RESOURCE_COORD_ID,RESOURCE_GENERATION,SOURCE_ROW_ID,SOURCE_FINGERPRINT,ACTION,STATE,REQUEST_ID,TARGET_ID,ATTEMPT_ID,BINDING_REVISION,SOURCE_ACTION,INTENT_KEY,INTENT_FINGERPRINT FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE WHERE SOURCE_COORD_ID=#{sourceId} AND INTENT_KEY=#{intentKey} AND BINDING_REVISION=0 ORDER BY SOURCE_GENERATION) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET WHERE ID=#{targetId} AND VALID_FROM=#{from,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND VALID_TO=#{to,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
SELECT WINDOWS FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE WHERE ID=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE WHERE RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resourceId} AND ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId} AND BINDING_REVISION < 0
SELECT OPERATION_VERSION FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET WHERE ID=#{targetId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE WHERE SOURCE_COORD_ID=#{sourceId} AND SOURCE_GENERATION=#{generation} AND RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resourceId} AND BINDING_REVISION > 0 AND TARGET_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE WHERE SOURCE_COORD_ID=#{sourceId} AND SOURCE_GENERATION=#{generation} AND RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resourceId} AND BINDING_REVISION > 0 AND REQUEST_ID=#{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE SET REQUEST_ID=#{requestId} WHERE ID=#{id} AND BINDING_REVISION=0 AND REQUEST_ID=#{expectedRequestId} AND TARGET_ID IS NULL
